description: PolyBase ops view: install/enable, compute-node health, DMS workers, distributed requests/steps, external work/operations, catalog inventory lists, and full recent node error details. Collector: mssql_polybase.

targets.expr: count((max by (instance) (mssql_polybase_enabled{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) == 1) and on (instance) ((max by (instance) (mssql_polybase_external_tables{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}) > 0) or (max by (instance) (mssql_polybase_external_data_sources{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}) > 0) or (count by (instance) (mssql_polybase_external_table_info{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}) > 0) or (count by (instance) (mssql_polybase_external_data_source_info{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}) > 0))) or vector(0)

(sum(mssql_polybase_external_workers{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", status="Failed"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(mssql_polybase_dms_workers{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", status="Failed"}) or vector(0))
count(count by (instance, db) (mssql_polybase_external_tables{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"})) or vector(0)
max by (instance, compute_node_id, node_type, node_name) (mssql_polybase_compute_node_info{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Max Request Start Age by Status

targets.expr: sum by (instance, location_type, operation_type, status) (mssql_polybase_request_steps{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"})
max by (instance, location_type, operation_type, status) (mssql_polybase_request_step_max_elapsed_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"})
max by (instance, db, schema, table, data_source, file_format, location) (mssql_polybase_external_table_info{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"})
max by (instance, db, source_name, source_type, location) (mssql_polybase_external_data_source_info{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"})
max by (instance, db, format_name, format_type) (mssql_polybase_external_file_format_info{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"})

targets.expr: max by (instance, compute_node_id, error_type, source, error_id, execution_id, spid, details) (mssql_polybase_node_error_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"})
